messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — service: inference-gateway (high 5xx rate)
incident-bot: Alert details: 5xx rate > 10% over 5m; region=eu-west-2; route=/v1/generate; trigger=error_ratio_threshold

alice_sre: acked. oncall here, switching to triage.
marc_platform: thanks, joining. any suspect deploys?
alice_sre: no deploys in last 30m. metrics show spike at 12:02 UTC. noise from many clients.
paula_prod: customer-impact dashboards show ~0.8% of requests affected for top-tier customers, but error bursts for small batch jobs.
alice_sre: running quick query:
```
rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5..",route="/v1/generate",region="eu-west-2"}[5m])
```
-> ~220 reqs/s 5xx, baseline ~8 reqs/s
marc_platform: checking kvcache evictions and qps to model-proxy
paula_prod: logs snippet:
```
2024-04-05T12:02:14Z gateway ERROR request failed: upstream "model-proxy-3" timeout
2024-04-05T12:02:15Z gateway ERROR upstream "model-proxy-2" 502 Bad Gateway
```
alice_sre: rolling through runbook step 1: rotate model-proxy pool to newer instances -> /runbooks/inference/5xx-heatmap
marc_platform: running quick recycle of model-proxy-2/3
sre-deploy-bot: Deploy started: model-proxy v2.14 -> replacing 2 instances
alice_sre: added temporary rate-limit to /v1/generate for anonymous clients: 50r/s
paula_prod: applying request-sampling to reduce fanout to backends
marc_platform: after recycle 12:06 -> 5xx down to ~15 reqs/s
alice_sre: after rate-limit + recycle at 12:08 -> error rate back to baseline, traffic normalizing
paula_prod: customers: sent quick note to top-10: brief status update
alice_sre: root cause looks like model-proxy worker threads exhausted under specific prefix cache churn — escalation to eng-runtime
eng-runtime-lead: digging into memory/threads. suspected regression in pooling patch 2.14? (investigating)
alice_sre: keeping page open for monitoring. will reopen if rate > 2% again
paula_prod: scheduling 1:1 with affected customer tomorrow, customer success on it
alice_sre: mitigation summary: recycled model-proxy pool, applied temporary rate-limits, enabled sampling. rollback not needed.
marc_platform: postmortem scheduled: 2024-04-06 15:00 UTC in #postmortems
alice_sre: closing page in PD after monitoring ok :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged and auto-closed after resolution window
